_readme: MiniMax H3 on Higgsfield: under test for 3D-animated (family-3d) swipes, owner 12 Nov 2026 ("with these cartoon videos we should test a new video model"). Not the house default; Seedance 2.5 stays the default until a curator rules.
SOURCES ARE FLAGGED. Parameters and constraints read live from the Higgsfield CLI (`higgsfield model get minimax_h3`, `generate cost`, 2026-11-12). No official prompt guide read yet.

THE FACTS THAT SHAPE THE DOOR: start_image (and end_image) cannot be mixed with reference media, so a take is image-to-video from the approved start picture, or reference mode without a start picture. Audio references need an image or video reference. Output is 2K only; duration 4-15 s.
